items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you used to do with Andy >> [INTERVIEWEE] Kirk? Yeah.

ctx.x: Well you know, Floyd Smith, I don't know if you ever heard him, you used to do with Andy

He had some deal with that electricity where he would amplify the sound of his guitar, and I never have seen it. But you know they would have resonators and different things. Yeah, well he used to play fine guitar, boy.
